terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.body:
## 1. About these terms

These Terms & Conditions govern your use of the {store} website and any purchase you make from {company}, registered at {place}. By using the website or placing an order, you agree to these terms and to our [Privacy Policy](/policies/privacy/).

## 2. Eligibility and accounts

You must be at least 18 years old, or use the website under the supervision of a parent or guardian. You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential and for activity under your account.

## 3. Products and pricing

- Prices are shown in Indian Rupees (₹) and include applicable taxes unless stated otherwise.
- We make every effort to display products, colours and descriptions accurately; slight variations may occur.
- Availability is not guaranteed until your order is confirmed. In the event of a pricing or listing error, we may cancel the affected order and refund any amount paid.

## 4. Orders and payment

An order is an offer to purchase. It is accepted when we confirm it by email or in your account. Payments are processed securely by our payment partners (Stripe, Razorpay and Cashfree). We may decline or cancel orders suspected of fraud.

## 5. Shipping and delivery

Orders are usually delivered within [Delivery timeline]. Delivery times are estimates and may vary due to circumstances outside our control.

## 6. Returns, exchanges and refunds

Eligible items may be returned within [Return window], unused, with original tags and packaging. For hygiene reasons, opened fragrances cannot be returned unless faulty. Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method. [Contact us](/contact/) to start a return.

## 7. Intellectual property

All content on this website — including the {store} name, logo, designs, photography and text — belongs to us or our licensors and may not be used without our written permission.

## 8. Acceptable use

You agree not to misuse the website, including attempting to gain unauthorised access, interfering with its operation, or using it for any unlawful purpose.

## 9. Limitation of liability

To the extent permitted by law, our liability for any order is limited to the amount you paid for it. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have as a consumer under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

## 10. Governing law and disputes

These terms are governed by the laws of India. Courts at [City] shall have jurisdiction, subject to your rights as a consumer.

## 11. Grievance redressal

Complaints may be sent to our Grievance Officer, [Grievance Officer name], at [Grievance Officer email]. See our [Contact page](/contact/).

## 12. Changes

We may update these terms from time to time. The version published on this page applies to your use of the website.
